en: Huh? Captain, what are you\nlooking at?

It's a TV show from our next
destination, an advanced
planet. It's showing live footage
of the Milky Quintet.
What!? Ours!?
Oh, that's footage from a live\nperformance a while back.

Idol activities are huge here!
They're even broadcasting
shows about popular idols from
other star systems.

I'm so happy people are
watching our footage and
supporting us, even this far
from the planet where we
performed.
Oh? A breaking news report...?

A romance scandal for the
popular space idols Milky
Quintet"... Wait, what is this
supposed to mean!?
This is bad, Captain! It's a huge\nscandal!!
...Wait, did something happen\nover here too?
They're broadcasting news that\na romance scandal has been\nrevealed for the Milky Quintet!
What?! A scoop like that right\nunder our noses!?
Of course not! It's fake news,\ntotally fake!
This photo... it's from when we\nall went out shopping before.
They've gone to the trouble of\ncropping it so only the part\nwith the Captain is visible.
True, if you only saw this, you\nmight get the wrong idea...
A fake scandal article, huh...\nThings are getting suspicious\non this end, too.

As for me, there are reports of
many young girls going missing
on our destination, the
advanced planet Twinkle Dust.
Girls going missing!?
I don't know the details yet,\nbut apparently the missing girls\nall have one thing in common.
That commonality is that they\nwere all "Idol Audition winners"...

Could it be that someone is
trying to hold an idol live
concert just for themselves,
like Head Bull...!

That is something we cannot
ignore. We were planning to
resupply here anyway, so shall
we ask around the locals?
But if we get kidnapped like we\ndid that one time, it'll all be for\nnothing.

But we won't find anything just
staying here. Let's split into
small groups and go
investigate!

Male Fan: ...So, you've heard
the new <font color=yellow>GNG48</font> song yet,
right? My fave was absolutely
incredible.
Female Fan: Everyone's heard\nit. Milky Quintet wasn't bad, but\nGNG is definitely where it's at!
...I see. So this idol group called\nGNG48 is quite popular.

To confirm idol rumors, we
should talk to fans. Let's start
by looking into the most
popular group, GNG48.
Haggard Man: Are you lot\nlooking into GNG?
Eh... Who are you?

Haggard Man: Sorry to
approach you so suddenly. I'm
no threat. Actually, I've been
looking into GNG myself.

Haggard Man: My daughter is
in GNG... but she went to a
concert near the interplanetary
conflict and I haven't been able
to reach her.
You can't reach her?! And a\nconcert near a conflict zone?\nWhat on earth is going on?!

Haggard Man: She said it was
a tour for the soldiers... but I'm
so worried she's been caught
up in the fighting...

Haggard Man: I contacted the
agency, but they won't give me
details to prevent their
schedules from leaking.

I see... that's worrying. We're
also investigating. I'll give you
our contact info; let's exchange
information if we find anything.

Haggard-looking Man: Thank
you. But that agency has
unsettling rumors. Please, be
careful.
Yes, I know. You take care too.
Ah, there you are! Captain,\nChisato, I've looked into a few\nthings!

An idol group called GNG48 is
popular on this planet, and it
seems their agency holds a
massive amount of power.

But that agency, <font color=yellow>Beyond Over
Production</font>, doesn't seem to
have very good rumors
surrounding it.
Like they're holding leverage\nover rival idol groups, or just\ngathering Girls indiscriminately.
It's possible that what\nhappened to Milky Quintet was\nthe work of this agency...

Thank you, both of you. GNG48
and that agency, Beyond Over
Production, are definitely
suspicious.

Even so, idol activities are
thriving with Twinkle Dust. No
matter where you go, there's a
girl performing on the street.

Songs and smiles are
everywhere; it's a wonderful
planet. Seeing them work so
hard gives me energy.
Ah! I was actually a little\ncurious about that.

When I listen to their songs, I
feel like energy is welling up
from deep inside me. It's
almost like... Symbology...
Miki, you hit the nail on the\nhead!
Hey, wait! You can't just barge\ninto the comms like that, you\nstartled me!
Ah, my apologies! I simply got a\nbit carried away...

Analyzing the songs, it seems
the women of this planet use
song-based Symbology to
enhance others' physical
abilities.
Using songs as a medium...\nthey're just like the Fox Spirit\npeople.

They're gathering girls
indiscriminately. The GNG48
members from the charity
concert are unreachable. Their
songs possess Symbology
power.
The key to solving this incident\nshould be around here.

I agree. For your worried
father, I'll first investigate the
conflict zone where the girls
went for their charity concert!
Male Fan: ...Hey. Are those the\nmembers of Milky Quintet over\nthere...?
Oh no! Did they spot us!?
A-Anyway, let's get back\nbefore this turns into a scene!

This is the analysis footage of
the sector where the conflict is
occurring. Seeing this sight, it
really is...
I can't believe something like\nthis is actually happening...!
Captain, everyone. We're back.

I heard you went to investigate
those strange incidents
happening on the planet
Twinkle Dust.
...So you're saying Beyond Over\nProduction has been\nkidnapping girls?

Yes. It seems idol girls are
being sent to interplanetary
conflict zones under the guise
of an orchestra to provide
combat support.

Furthermore, to prevent leaks,
it seems the girls are being
kept in environments where
they can't communicate with
the outside world...

Even that scandal seems like a
fabrication to crush other idol
groups and concentrate all the
girls into their own agency.

We won't be staying in this
sector for long. The scandal is
one thing, but the real problem
is the members of GNG.
Yeah. That's why I'm thinking of\ntrying to talk to the GNG girls\nfirst.
Can you actually get in touch\nwith the idols?
Don't worry! Chisato, who is\nstill investigating on-site,\nlooked into it for us.

Coro, please get in touch with
the members of GNG48. Use a
secure line so the production
company doesn't find out.
Understood! I'll open the line\nimmediately!

Hello? Can you hear me? This
is the exploration combat ship
GFSS-3214F, currently docked
at Twinkle Dust.
GNG48 Member: "Huh? Who is\nthis? This line is for members\nonly..."
GNG48 Member: "Wait... Are\nyou guys... the Milky Quintet...?"

Yes. I've connected this
transmission because there's
something I absolutely need
you to know.

To put it bluntly, all you
members of GNG48, I want you
to leave GNG48 immediately
and run away.
GNG48 Member: "What...?!\nW-what are you talking\nabout?!"

Beyond Over Production is
exploiting your unique Gem
arts. They might force you to
join the conflict!

GNG48 Member: "...Who are
you, calling us out of the blue
with such nonsense?! No one is
going to believe such a
ridiculous story!!

Please, calm down and listen!
Haven't there been members
you've lost contact with? Think
about it carefully!
GNG48 Member: "Th-that's..."

Oh my, oh my, oh my? I
thought it was getting a bit
noisy... It's the Milky Quintet,
isn't it?
Eve: You...!
GNG48 Producer: "Greetings. I\nam the General Producer for\nGNG48."

GNG48 Producer: "Now, now.
Just because you've hit a
scandal doesn't mean you
should try to crush your rivals.
Eve: I wonder which one of us\nis actually doing that?

GNG48 Producer: "I don't know
what you mean, but if you care
about GNG, let's settle this like
idols on stage!

GNG48 Producer: "In a festival
showdown, with the reputation
and existence of our
respective groups on the line."
Eve: Disbandment...
Eve: Fine, I accept your\nchallenge!

GNG48 Producer: "What a
delightful response. Well then, I
shall look forward to the day of
the festival. Ha ha ha ha!"
Eve: ...Everyone, I'm sorry. I just\nsaid we'd do the festival on\nimpulse.
Don't worry, Eve, you were so\ncool!

Besides, Milky Quintet was
formed to protect everyone
from unreasonable forces. Now
is the time to stand up!

It seems they have discovered
our movements. We had no
choice but to accept the
challenge.
However, if it comes to this,\nthe scandal will surely have\nrepercussions.
You're right. I wonder if the\nfans will continue to support us\nas they always have...
Hmm, a sister unit to Milky\nQuintet, is it?
Well, forming a new unit is the\nbest way to generate buzz. But\nwhat about the members?
Um, could I help with that too?

Using their songs as tools for
combat and dragging them into
conflict... I can't just stand by
and watch such cruelty!
Using... their power...
See, Karlyn, you think so too,\nright?

You're right... As a survivor of
the Fox Spirit people, I won't
let such a tragedy happen
again.
Then it's settled! Karlyn, you\nbecome an idol with us!
Me, an idol with you, Tika!?
Th-that's impossible! There's no\nway I could wear cute outfits\nand spread smiles everywhere.
That's not true! You're a great\nsinger, you're beautiful, and\nyou'd be perfect!

You have to try new things,
Karlyn. You said yourself just
the other day that it was time
to try something new.
I meant things like piloting the\nship! I never even considered\nbeing an idol...
Karlyn... is it really a no?
...F-fine. But only to protect\neveryone in GNG48!
Ehehe, then our idol debut is\nofficially decided!

Now that it's settled, let the
lessons begin! The entire Milky
Quintet will work together to
turn you two into idols!
A live performance already...?\nNow I'm actually getting\nnervous~.
I've learned everything an idol\nneeds to know. All that's left is\nto step onto the stage.
Yeah...!
GNG48 Member: So you two\nare the Milky Quintet sister\nunit?

GNG48 Member: It seems like
you're trying to get us
disbanded, but we can't lose to
a group like that!

You might not understand right
now, but if you stay in GNG,
you're definitely going to
suffer.
That's why we're going to win\nhere...!
Our live performance was much\nmore exciting, so just let the\nrest of GNG48 go!
GNG48 Producer: Yes, good\nwork today. As of today, the\nGNG third string is disbanded.
GNG48 Member: Producer, you\ncan't be serious...!
Third string...? What is that\nsupposed to mean?

GNG48 Producer: It means
they are nothing like the
center-class first string;
they're just little chicks.
Then we'll just have to beat\nthe first string. Bring those\ngirls to me immediately.

GNG48 Producer:
Unfortunately, they're busy.
First, show us you can beat
the second string. Until next
time.
Look at all these people! So\nthis is a GNG event...!
I suppose being an idol involves\nmore than just standing on a\nstage.
I know. We're here to find out\nwhat we're lacking, aren't we?
Captain, look over there!\nThere's a huge line, I wonder\nwhat they're doing?
Oh, so that's what a handshake\nevent is.
Even idols get to interact with\ntheir fans that closely, huh?
The fans and the GNG girls\nlook like they're having so\nmuch fun talking!
Hearing words of support\ndirectly from people must give\nthem so much energy.
Yeah...
(Is everyone in GNG truly\nenjoying their idol activities...?)

(For those girls, GNG has
become a place where they
can make people smile. In that
case, we...)
Karlyn? What's wrong?
...No, it's nothing.

Really? Well, the Captain said
she's figured most of it out, so
let's head back. Come on, let's
go!
So Rena and Fayt will be\nteaching today's lesson.

Yep, looking forward to it.
Since I'm the one teaching, I'm
going to be strict, so make
sure you can keep up.
Verda and the others have\nalready been teaching you the\nidol basics, right?

That's why we're going to
practice Live MCing, which is
essential for hyping up the
stage!

I see. GNG was great at hyping
up handshake events. If we
don't do even better than that,
we won't stand a chance at
the festival.
Exactly! Now, I'll show you how\nit's done.
Hey, everyone! Thank you so\nmuch for coming to see us\ntoday!!
Wow... I can almost hear the\ncheering.
Hehe, thank you.

To hype up the audience, you
have to enjoy yourself too! Try
to act as if you're actually on a
Live Stage.
Um... Hey, everyone! Thank you\nso much for coming to see us\ntoday!!
...Everyone! Thank you for\ncoming!
Yes, Tika, you nailed it! You\nmight even be better than me\nnow.
Y-you think so...? I'm glad.

Karlyn, being cool is your
charm, but you need more
energy to reach your fans.
Don't be so shy!
It's not like I'm embarrassed...\nFine, let's try it one more time.
Hehe. Good luck, Karlyn!

Don't get too ahead of
yourself, Tika. I heard Karlyn is
much better at singing and
dancing than you are.
Wah...! Y-yes!
Alright, we don't have much\ntime, so let's keep moving!
GNG48 Member: Everyone! We\nhope you'll all have a blast at\nour live show today!
Audience: OOOOOOOO!!
The GNG girls really are\namazing at MCing...! I can feel\nthe whole venue becoming one.
Yeah...

GNG48 Member: GNG will never
disband, because we want to
keep seeing you all at our lives!
So please, give us all your
support!

(Those girls are just desperate
to protect their home... Just
like I was, fighting to protect
the Fox Spirit people...)
Ah, it's our turn! Let's go!
(No, I can't. I need to stop\noverthinking and focus on the\nstage.)
One, two, three, four! One, two,\nthree...
Stop!
I think Karlyn might have been\nrunning a bit too fast during\nthat part.
We're a unit, so you need to\nstay in sync with Tika.
I'm sorry... Could we try that\none more time?

Oh, before that... Our next
festival battle is against the
A-list members, so we'll need
to perform with more precision.

I think it would be better if you
all paid more attention to each
other's movements and what
the others are thinking.
Yes, you're right. It's not good\nto push yourselves too hard,\nso let's take a short break.
Phew...
Karlyn, can I talk to you for a\nsecond?
Yes. Are you talking about that\nlast part?
Ah, no! It's not that. I was just\nwondering if something was\nbothering you.

That's not true. It's just that
I'm not used to being an idol
yet. I simply have a lot on my
mind.

But ever since we went to see
the GNG48 Event, you've
seemed troubled sometimes,
haven't you?
...So you noticed.
Ehehe, we're a unit, after all!
...Hey, Tika. Do you really think\ndisbanding GNG is the right\nsolution?

Of course! Because if we don't
set them free, their Gem Arts
will just be forced into being
tools for conflict!
That is something that should\nnever be allowed. But still...
Those girls perform so they\ncan bring smiles to the people\nwho need them.

Even those called second or
third tier members practiced
desperately, performing at
events and lives for their fans.
And yet, I am the one who took\naway their future... their place\nto belong.
Karlyn...
Looking toward tomorrow... in\nDaftine, where you used to\nlive...
I wonder if the Fox Soul people\nare living in peace?
That's...
Or... I wonder if the word "Fox\nSoul" doesn't even exist\nanymore.
...To you, Karlyn, everyone in\nGNG48 is just like the Fox Soul\npeople, isn't it?

The Fox Soul people... because
they had strong Gem power,
they were needed by Givel and
the people of Baschen.

Everyone in GNG became idols
because they had special Gem
power, and they give strength
to their fans.
Being needed is a precious\nthing. That fact becomes your\nplace to belong.
I understand that feeling.\nBecause everyone on this ship\nis that to me.

But that's exactly why I don't
want them to stay in a fake
place like GNG48, which is only
meant for military use.
GNG might be a fake place, but\nthe fans' cheers are real. They\ntruly support them.
Yeah, that's why I think it'll be\nokay.
What do you mean, "it'll be\nfine"...?

Because the members of
GNG48 work so hard just to
live up to the fans'
expectations.
I'm sure they'll all be able to\nfind their own true place\nthrough their own strength.

...You're right, Tika. A place to
belong isn't something given to
you; it's something you must go
out and find for yourself.
Yeah! Just like how you and I\nfound our place on this ship,\nKarlyn!
...We've taken quite a long\nbreak, haven't we? Shall we\nhead back to our lessons?
Tika. I know we'll win the next\nfestival, too.
Yeah...!
Thank you all so much for\ncoming to our live show today!
We're going to sing songs that\nwill become your best\nmemories... so, will you listen?
Audience: OOOOOOH!!
This street live was a huge\nsuccess! You two were\namazing!
Before I knew it, so many\npeople had gathered that I got\nreally nervous...!
Hehe... I never imagined a day\nwould come where so many\npeople would listen to us sing.
A unit that performs at\nfestivals with GNG's top tier is\ngetting a lot of attention.
It looks like quite a few people\nbecame fans of you two after\nwatching today's live!

They're even calling you the
rising stars following in the
footsteps of Milky Quintet. You
two are truly fine idols now!
Fine idols, huh... I never\ndreamed things would turn out\nlike this.
I'm so glad I get to be an idol\nwith you, Karlyn!
I think we had such a fun\nstage today because I was\nwith you!
You're right, it was fun...
...Are you still worried about\neveryone in GNG?

I'm sorry... When I think about
how much those girls must be
enjoying the stage too, I can't
help it.
But what I must do right now is\nguide them to the right place...
Karlyn. An idol shouldn't make\nsuch a scary face.

Try to remember today's live
show clearly. So many people
came just to see your
performance, didn't they?

Everyone is cheering because
they want to see your smiles.
So, for the sake of your fans,
you mustn't forget to smile!
You're right... We are idols,\nafter all.
Liberating them is key, but we\nmust also bring wonderful\nsmiles to all our fans!
Ehehe... I'm looking forward to\nseeing your best smile too, Sis!
Hehe, you can look forward to\nit.
GNG48 Center: Oh, you\nactually showed up instead of\nrunning away.
Of course. There are fans\nwaiting for us in this venue.

GNG48 Center: Hmph, you
certainly have the spirit. Fine,
I'll show you the difference in
our class!
Amazing... Their singing and\ndancing are on a whole\ndifferent level...!
So this is their true strength.\nBut... something feels off.
Eh? What's wrong, Karlyn?
No!! We have to stop the song\nright now! Something terrible is\ngoing to happen!!
Kyaa! What do you mean!? This\nhas never happened in any of\ntheir previous lives!!

It must be resonating with that
Center girl's emotions, causing
her Gem Arts to go out of
control. If this continues, things
will get bad...

GNG48 Producer: Ha-ha-ha-ha!
Wonderful, simply wonderful!
More, more, more! Let your
emotions swell!
You...!

GNG48 Producer: I'm grateful. I
gathered girls capable of using
arts, but I struggled to find a
way to draw out their true
power.
GNG48 Center: The singing,\nthe dancing... it's so powerful...!\nI can win... I want to win...!

GNG48 Producer: I never
imagined things would go so
perfectly! With this power, the
clients will surely be satisfied,
fuhahaha!
Karlyn! The Gem arts power of\nthe other girls is gathering into\nthe Center girl!
Stop singing this instant!\nOtherwise, your body won't be\nable to take it!
GNG48 Center: I won't... let\npeople like you... have this\nstage...
GNG48 Center: I'll... NEVER... let\nanyone... steal it!
No, it's like she can't hear us!

(That strange scent of Gems...!
This feeling is exactly like when
those others were transforming
into monsters!!)
Male Fan: Aaaaaahhh!
Female Fan: ...W-what is\nhappening...? H-help... me...
GNG48 Center: ...!!
I'll handle guiding the audience\nto safety! Karlyn, Tika, please\nlook after the rest of GNG!!
GNG48 Center: A... aaaah...\nN-no...
GNG48 Center: N-No... You...\neveryone... r-run...

(That's right. No matter what
happens, you are idols. You
can't let your fans suffer like
this.)
(As long as your hearts are still\nin this, we can fight together!!)
Sorry, but this festival is\ncanceled!
GNG48 Center: U-Ugh...\nN-Nooo...!
Big sister!
Yes, we can still save them! We\nhave to suppress the spell's\nrampage!

Announcer: "...Regarding the
incident where GNG48
members experienced strange
phenomena during their live, it
seems their agency may know
something...
Everyone is still talking about\nthat concert.

Don't you think it's because
Chisato released that massive
expose with so much evidence
right after the incident?

Everyone was shocked to find
out that while they were
outwardly an idol agency, they
were secretly plotting to use
idols for military purposes.

The many fans at the venue
are the best witnesses. Beyond
Over Production won't be able
to wiggle out of this one.
So, will all those idol girls be\nable to go back to their normal\nlives?

The agency is closing, but
reports say the top-tier
members are starting a new
one to keep working.
Having to start all over again\nfrom scratch... that sounds so\ndifficult.
Those girls will be fine, I'm sure.\nBecause...
The reaction from the Gem\nArts has stopped... It won't go\nout of control again, will it?

No. The other girls' songs have
ceased, and she has exhausted
herself severely... She shouldn't
be able to move for a while.
GNG48 Center: Ugh... uuu...\nHow are the fans? Is...\neveryone unhurt...?
...Yes. Everyone is fine. No one\nelse will get hurt, thanks to all\nyour hard work.
So, you should get some rest\ntoo.
GNG48 Center: Oh... thank\ngoodness...

...Because GNG48 are the best
idols, who truly care for their
fans from the bottom of their
hearts.

You're right. This incident will
have consequences, but if they
stay serious about being idols,
I'm sure they'll become popular
again.

Even setting aside those
special powers, their
performance was truly
energizing.
Yes... I feel the same way.
Now we just need to figure out\nwhat to do about that fake\nnews regarding Milky Quintet.

They say rumors die down in
seventy-five days; if we stay
quiet until things cool off, it
should settle.
As for the Milky Quintet\nscandal, look! It's already been\nretracted as a hoax!
This article... did you write it,\nChisato?

I contacted Beyond Over
Production's Executive
Director. Given the situation,
they retracted it without much
of a fight.
Not just the expose, but\ngetting the scandal retracted\ntoo... Chisato, you're amazing!

While you all were working hard
as idols, I was running around
raising funds to establish a
new production company.
Captain, when did you do all\nthat!? You've been right there\nwith us for all our lessons!

They said they couldn't take
away these girls' place just
because of our circumstances
and the production's issues.
Right, Captain?
(...Looking at those girls, the\nCaptain felt the same way I\ndo.)
Hehe, it's nothing. It's just,\nwell...
I just realized that this is it...\nthis ship where the Captain is,\nis where I belong.
A lot has happened, but this is\nfinally settled!
I see. So being idols is over\nnow.
Are you lonely?
Yeah. Because I had so much\nfun standing on stage with you,\nSis.

It feels a bit lonely for us too,
knowing this is the last time
we'll see the two of you on
stage.
You two were really starting to\nlook the part as idols, too.
It would be so much fun if we\ncould all perform on the same\nstage someday!

That sounds lovely. Milky
Quintet, with Tika and Karlyn,
and Fayt and Rena, all
together.
Thinking about it this way, it's\nclear the Captain has raised\nquite a lot of idols!
Don't be so modest. Our\nsuccess as idols is thanks to\nthe Captain's skill.

If the number of idols keeps
growing, the Captain might end
up creating a massive idol
group like GNG48 someday!
Ahaha... that sounds like it\nwould be one incredible stage.
But it sounds so exciting!
If our songs are ever needed\nagain, I'd love for us all to\nstand on stage together.
And of course, we'll be\ntogether then too, Karlyn.

You're right... Being idols is one
of the places we belong. It
might be nice to sing for
someone else again.

This story has concluded. We
plan to release various other
stories in the future. Please
look forward to them.
